title: AUTHORIZE the Chief Executive Officer to: A. ESTABLISH a Life-of-Project (LOP) budget for the Doran Street Grade Separation Project (Project) in the amount…
text:
[Metro Board file 2026-0529, Project]
[CONSTRUCTION COMMITTEE MADE THE FOLLOWING RECOMMENDATION (3-0):]
AUTHORIZE the Chief Executive Officer to: 

A.	ESTABLISH a Life-of-Project (LOP) budget for the Doran Street Grade Separation Project (Project) in the amount of $116,242,594; 

B.	NEGOTIATE and EXECUTE all contracts, modifications, and agreements up to the authorized LOP budget for the Doran Street Grade Separation Project; and  

C.	AMEND the FY27 budget for the Doran Street Grade Separation Project by $8,497,108 for a total of $30,348,345.
